set_aside.subject: R0-86 and the import-projects output
set_aside.text: “those projects under the identities they carry, with their customers, objects, rooms and pointers (ids kept), links intact” conflicts with R0-86’s “the object has no id of its own” and “The import carries it inside its project.”
set_aside.question: Does “ids kept” and “links intact” exclude the object, so that import keeps project, customer, room and pointer identities while importing the object only as embedded project data?
options: The object is embedded data with no id or independent link; only the other records keep ids and links.
Imported objects retain an identity or link despite newly created objects having none.
set_aside.default_guess: Apply R0-86: exclude the object from “ids kept” and “links intact” and import it as embedded project data.
